visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a close-up overhead shot of four silver lipstick tubes and three decorative cases with the Dior logo and various patterns (blue monogram, dark pink monogram, and light pink quilted) laid out on a textured beige stone surface under bright, direct sunlight that creates sharp shadows. (2) A young woman with dark, shoulder-length hair and fair skin appears in a medium close-up. She is wearing a soft pink knit cardigan and looks toward the camera with a subtle smile while touching her hair. The scene is lit by warm, natural light from the side, creating a soft glow on her face. (3) A split-screen layout appears. The top section shows a close-up of a forearm where a silver lipstick tube is being swiped to reveal a warm reddish-brown color. The bottom section shows the woman applying the same lipstick shade to her lips while looking into the camera lens in a brightly lit indoor space. (4) The split-screen continues with a new shade. The upper half shows a pinkish-red swatch being applied to the arm, while the lower half shows the woman holding a pink quilted lipstick case near her face and smiling. She then poses with her hand behind her neck, looking pleased with the makeup. (5) A third deep red shade is introduced via the split-screen swatching on the upper half. In the lower half, the woman applies the lipstick and then holds the tube horizontally below her chin, smiling directly at the camera. (6) The video concludes with a shot of the forearm showing four distinct color swatches with text labels, followed by a final close-up of the lipstick products arranged on the stone surface again.
